text:
The purpose of this meeting was to align Companion Animal Travel Desk operations for traveler and pet coordination on Aurelia Skyways. 

Attendees: the passenger coordinator, the cabin team lead, the ground liaison, Caleb Berg, Mateo Park, and Maggie.

The passenger coordinator opened with an overview of the required travel steps, emphasizing clear handoffs from intake through check-in and onward to cabin monitoring. The team agreed that travelers should receive simple guidance on documentation readiness and on how Maggie will be handled at each stage, with calm, consistent expectations.

The ground liaison reviewed the desk workflow for booking-related actions and noted that records must be updated immediately after every confirmation to prevent mismatches between traveler instructions and handling notes. <<FACT F097>> the senior coordinator will ensure our internal checklist stays aligned with the booking system’s status signals.

The cabin team lead described in-flight monitoring priorities, including observation cadence, quiet handling, and immediate reporting if Maggie shows stress. <<FACT F106>> the cabin team lead will ensure any escalation path is used consistently when transfer coordination requires additional support.

For check-in readiness, the group focused on timing discipline and the importance of verifying Maggie’s container labeling and suitability before gate handoff. <<FACT F092>> we will standardize reminders so the desk can complete required steps before the cabin team takes over monitoring.

Caleb Berg and Mateo Park shared their preferences for communication style, and the team will reflect that in traveler updates. The desk also confirmed that contingency handling will be documented in plain language for quick reference during busy periods.

The meeting ended with next steps assigned and shared confirmations scheduled.
